messages:
sam: hey team, first-week question — i can view infra dashboards but the edit toggle is dimmed and i get a 403 when trying to create a panel. also Sentry shows "Project hidden" for infra-service. who owns the perms for these?

leah: welcome @sam! Grafana edit roles are handled via the access portal and require both role + folder ACL. Sentry invites come from the service owners or elena. Did you sign in with SSO or a separate email?

elena: i can add you to the Sentry project. if you see "Project hidden" it's usually an org membership issue. DM me the email you used to login and i'll invite you to infra-service-prod.

sam: signed in with sam@redwood.dev via SSO. DM sent. quick follow-up: is there a difference between "Grafana Editor" and "Dashboard Editor" in our portal? i can't find folder ACL docs.

leah: good question — our portal labels can be confusing. "Grafana Editor" grants the base editor role; for folder-level ACLs include the folder name in the request (e.g., platform-dashboards). Without the ACL you can open dashboards but not change permissions or edit some panels. Add your team tag "infra-core" in the request.

devex-bot: To request Grafana Editor: https://internal.redwood.com/access-requests -> select "Grafana Editor" -> add team tag (infra-core) -> include folder name (platform-dashboards) -> justification: "onboarding: edit infra dashboards, update CPU alert thresholds". For faster approval react :rocket: or ping #eng-oncall.

observability-bot: Note: when editing alert thresholds please record changes in the alert-change log: https://git.internal.redwood.com/infra/alert-changes and add monitor tag team:infra-core.

eng-oncall: @sam if this is tied to noisy prod alerts, include "prod-impact" in the access request. we can temporarily silence noisy monitors while you make changes. Ping here when the request is approved and we'll do a quick review.

sam: thanks — requested Grafana Editor with folder ACL and included prod-impact. accepted Sentry invite. will paste panel link and proposed threshold in this thread for quick review once edit access arrives.

leah: welcome aboard! one tip: small alert tweaks are easier if you open a short PR in infra-alerts repo mentioning the incident window. keeps oncall in the loop and speeds approvals. :thumbsup:
